<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/reports/catalogue-growth/freshness"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Returns now minus the newest event time the projector has applied, or 0 when the read model is empty. The catalogue changes rarely, so this grows steadily between operator edits even when the projector is fully caught up: it is "time since the last projected change", not consumer lag.
